role: All-12 same-first-error by two-action exact one-site structural discriminator; prerequisite to any new complete second law
question: Does any one of the twelve pre-existing same-first-record physical-error alternatives have a provably different second public one-site charge marginal from the base under either frozen relation-free action?
source_basis: J7T frozen twelve-error support and sparse restricted-IID prior
J7M base complete second public law and both actions
J7W exact null for two previously selected peers
pre_acceptance_amendment: After a successful draft calculation but before evidence acceptance, add explicit exact-J7M base and exact-J7W peer marginal consistency assertions; no matrix, method, budget, or scientific outcome changed. Re-execute the pinned final runner and use only its replacement result.
frozen_model: Paper-normalized ideal periodic L=2 D4 projector orbit, J7S/J7T twelve pre-existing physical red-X alternatives, same complete first binary public charge/flux/vacuum record and selected positive first mass; J7M public actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35] are fixed without private-error access. No new error support, geometry, rate, observation, action, or score.

matrix.design: Cross every twelve J7T same-first error alternatives with both fixed actions; also replay base under each action. For each of 26 cells classify every eligible one-site second star as exact plus, minus, fair, or unresolved using all selected-first + projectors, operator anticommutation and initial-orbit stabilizer relations.
matrix.discriminator: A resolved candidate one-site label different from the resolved base label under the same action and site proves a different complete second public law. Matching or unresolved one-site labels do not prove law equality. No candidate is dropped based on prior weight or human ranking.
matrix.verification: Pin all inputs and runner before/after; replay same complete first and second flux; check first/second commuting operator sets; require twelve unique candidates, 24 candidate-action plus two base-control cells and exactly 22 eligible second sites per cell. Cross-check the two J7W peer one-site classifications against their known null before interpreting other cells.
matrix.uncertainty: Finite exact operator algebra on a selected ideal orbit; no Monte Carlo unit or interval. Selection and idealization limit interpretation.

acceptance: All twelve candidates, both actions and base controls are classified with pinned provenance and no private error visible to the action
A changed resolved one-site marginal is reported only as a complete-law difference witness, not quantified full law or information
J7W peers must not yield a spurious resolved one-site difference
No ordered-projector expansion, physical histories, arms, bootstrap or threshold work

outcomes.positive_witness: Register a separate bounded exact complete-law and restricted-prior information follow-up for every affordable positive candidate/action; do not select a favorable one post hoc.
outcomes.no_witness: Record the one-site structural null/unresolved boundary; it does not establish complete-law equality. Next prerequisite requires joint-correlation or distinct geometry design under a separate contract.
outcomes.censored: On pin, algebra, cap or runtime failure, release no second-law conclusion and preserve the failure.

stop_rule: Stop after the 26 registered cells or sooner on a gate failure; no complete law, full-IID posterior, logical risk, policy performance or new geometry is authorized by this screen.
